description: Joint application for erection of single storey rear and side infill extensions to both houses
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Unnumbered location plan, unnumbered proposed block plan, flood risk assessment, E101, P101. Received 02/05/19   ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the flank elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
Condition : 5 - The works hereby approved at land belonging to 49 Wolseley Gardens and 51 Wolseley Gardens must be undertaken as a single building operation.
